text: Black thought they won White's queen. Two moves later, checkmate landed on d5 The most famous minor-piece queen sacrifice in chess history. When Black pins the knight with Bg4, White calculates: 5.Nxe5! Bxd1 6.Bxf7+ Ke7 7.Nd5#. The lesson: Never capture an undefended queen without calculating forcing king checks first.
